channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Taylor Jenkins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Taylor Jenkins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Charles Lee on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Sam Perley:Charles Lee on working with now-Bucks Head Coach Taylor Jenkins in ATL/MIL:

“He was the guy I sat next to on the plane my very first year in the NBA (2014-15), and I was always impressed with how organized he was... He had his sorters - there were red, green, this and that.”

Charles Lee on Taylor Jenkins, Oct 11, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Fizdale on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Former Grizzlies coach David Fizdale weighed in on the situation during a SiriusXM NBA Radio interview, suggesting the friction between Morant and the organization began last year when Memphis fired Taylor Jenkins just before the playoffs.

“I don’t know what happened internally, but once you fire a coach of the caliber of Taylor Jenkins, that told me that something’s wrong,”

David Fizdale on Taylor Jenkins, Nov 5, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mike Brown, Michael Malone, Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle on Michael Malone, Mike Brown and Taylor Jenkins getting fired this season:

“If anyone would've told me any of these guys would've been fired midseason, I would've been shocked. ... It's disappointing,it's kinda numbing to be honest.”

Rick Carlisle on Mike Brown, Michael Malone, Taylor Jenkins, Apr 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Zach Kleiman on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Memphis GM Zach Kleiman:

“I’m genuinely appreciative of Taylor’s contributions to this team and this city over the past six seasons. This was a difficult decision given the consistent and tangible development of our players and overall success under Taylor’s leadership. I wish Taylor the very best going forward.”

Zach Kleiman on Taylor Jenkins, Mar 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“If it’s remotely close with me, they go to the monitor. They didn’t even go to the monitor and review it—it was that little. Butyou got Taylor Jenkins, oh, who’s a softy, who goes out, and at some point, you’d hope to think we’d beat y’all in the NBA Finals—not in the Finals, though, because they ain’t getting there. Not with him. We beat y’all in the NBA Playoffs because he was too emotional. And so then his team followed that—they follow your lead—and collapsed because they couldn’t deal with the emotions of it.”

Draymond Green on Taylor Jenkins, Nov 20, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Mike Budenholzer, Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Darvin Ham on the coaching matchup with Taylor Jenkins, who Ham coached alongside for years under Mike Budenholzer in Atlanta and Milwaukee:

“We’ll get to see who was right in all of those coaches meetings when we would argue.”

Darvin Ham on Mike Budenholzer, Taylor Jenkins, Apr 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Dane Moore:Patrick Beverley on Taylor Jenkins' comments about the officiating in Game 4:

“I seen the interview with coach Jenkins about the referees. Very interesting there... Coming from a young coach, that’s just something that you don’t do.”

Patrick Beverley on Taylor Jenkins, Apr 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Chris Finch on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
“I haven’t really thought about it a lot, but my personal choice would be Taylor Jenkins of Memphis because of what they have done in terms of exceeding expectations,”

Chris Finch on Taylor Jenkins, Mar 24, 2022. Source: Maxim.

item.title: Desmond Bane on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
“It started as soon as I touched down after the draft. It started with Coach (Taylor) Jenkins and the Grizzlies organization, of course. But as soon as I got to the hotel, people started bringing me gear and welcoming me with open arms. I’m thrilled to be a part of this team and be a part of Memphis.”

Desmond Bane on Taylor Jenkins, Jul 17, 2021. Source: Daily Memphian.

item.title: Ja Morant on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Morant said about his relationship with Jenkins.

“He’s very open with all the players, especially me. It’s just an honor to get the freedom to go out and play. Coach Jenkins allows me to play freely and trusts me enough to make plays. And that’s what every point guard wants.”

Ja Morant on Taylor Jenkins, Nov 14, 2019. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
“[Jenkins] has the overall knowledge of everything that it takes to be a head coach. It always starts with a high basketball acumen [...] but you also need an understanding of what’s happening in the [NBA] landscape,”

Mike Budenholzer on Taylor Jenkins, Nov 14, 2019. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Zach Kleiman on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
David Cobb:Zach Kleiman:

“Want to make it clear that we are taking the long view on this....the organization has made a significant commitment to Taylor, a long-term commitment.”

Zach Kleiman on Taylor Jenkins, Jun 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @DavidWCobb.

item.title: Zach Kleiman on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Grizzlies Executive Vice President of Basketball Operations Zachary Z. Kleiman said.

“Taylor has an excellent coaching pedigree and we are confident he will lay the groundwork of developing the young players on our roster while having the elite basketball acumen and forward-thinking positive vision to be a high-level NBA head coach.”

Zach Kleiman on Taylor Jenkins, Jun 11, 2019. Source: NBA.com.
